topics.label: Lecture opening and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and intended learning objectives for the lecture.

topics.label: Conventional modalities, cytotoxic chemotherapy, and drug resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional local and systemic cancer therapies alongside the toxicity and efflux-mediated resistance mechanisms that limit their efficacy.

topics.label: Therapies exploiting intrinsic tumor vulnerabilities and repair defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that selectively target tumor cell-cycle defects, hormone dependencies, and DNA repair deficiencies.

topics.label: Small-molecule kinase inhibitors and resistance pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on designing small-molecule inhibitors against oncogenic kinases and the subsequent emergence of structural, bypass, and paradoxical drug resistance.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibody therapies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the application of therapeutic antibodies to selectively block tumor surface receptors or deliver cytotoxic payloads directly to cancer cells.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and T-cell redirection strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the evidence for immune surveillance and describe modern immunotherapeutic strategies that harness or genetically engineer T cells to eliminate tumor cells.

topics.label: Systemic challenges, historical progress, and future directions in oncology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize broad clinical challenges, historical therapeutic advancements, and emerging conceptual paradigms in cancer management.
